about.description: WTIOIL is a commodity perpetual listed on Coinbase International Exchange, tracking Crude Oil (WTI), margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 15× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
